intro.title: Hart County Senior Center
intro.description: Programs, activities, excursions, social opportunities, and nutrition services for Hart County's older adults.

exterior.alt: Exterior of the Hart County Senior Center
exterior.caption: Hart County Senior Center

about: The Hart County Senior Center is located within the recreation park. It provides programs, activities, excursions, socialization, and nutrition services to older adults in Hart County.

eligibility.title: Who May Participate
eligibility.text: The Senior Center is open to Hart County residents age 60 and older.

gallery.alt: Hart County Senior Center participants enjoying a lake picnic
gallery.caption: Lake Picnic

gallery.alt: Hart County Senior Center group trip to The Varsity
gallery.caption: Trip to The Varsity

paragraphs: The Meals on Wheels program operates from the Senior Center. It provides a hot noon meal Monday through Friday to homebound people age 60 and older.
